name: Research Fabric
description: Production-oriented AI-native open-web research layer for Synapse: multi-provider discovery with failover/cache, authority-aware ranking, domain diversity, HTTP retrieval plus Web Scraper escalation, evidence hashes, corroboration/confidence scoring, prompt-injection diagnostics, and durable citation-ready receipts.

fields.label: Research question
fields.help: A factual question, comparison, market scan, technical topic, or research goal.

fields.label: Research mode
fields.help: instant favors latency, balanced is the default, deep expands more queries and sources.

fields.label: Search provider
fields.placeholder: auto | duckduckgo | google | brave | yahoo | exa
fields.help: auto tries Exa when configured, then independent no-key search providers with failover and short-lived search caching.

fields.label: Maximum sources
fields.help: Maximum number of ranked URLs to deeply retrieve.
